comments.body: 2026-11-09 evening, the owner: 'that's one of the things that we're also fixing tonight. When an agent is working, right now, there just seems to be like a 75% filled icon, blue icon, and it looks like it's supposed to be spinning, but it doesn't. I just think that's kind of weird design'. Folded into the sidebar-entry redesign (Lectern page muster-sidebar-entries, built tonight): the page offers the choice between a slowly turning icon (honoring Reduce Motion) and a shape that does not read as a spinner.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-09 on 0.24.0, right after upgrading from 0.22. The owner looked at two working panes in the agent list and asked: "the blue icon on the left doesn't spin, it's just frozen? same on that helper". Both were working; one was four minutes into a turn, its context climbing from 37% to 43%.

The icon is static by design. Fencil decision agent-list-rows gives each state a shape with no motion, and `StateIcon` draws working as a ring with a gap. The same decision dropped the context ring because "the ring read as a loading spinner". A ring with a gap reads the same way, and a spinner that never turns looks stuck, so a working agent reads as hung.

Possibly: turn the working icon slowly, honoring Reduce Motion, or give working a shape that does not look like a spinner. Either one revises agent-list-rows, so it is the owner's call.
title: The working icon reads as a frozen spinner
